messages:
Alex: Heads up 12:05 UTC1 observed a p99 tail in eu-west that isn't a single noisy tenant. Looks like many small warmups + parallel prefetches are aligning and pushing egress and kvcache regen simultaneously. Can we discuss a fairness + market approach?

Priya: I see it on the heatmap. Cross-host kvcache regen correlates with host-eq egress spikes. The current fallback to other regions is also increasing cross-region bandwidth costs when we shift traffic.

Omar: Two quick mitigation ideas: (1) dynamic egress weights on the router per-tenant to smooth bursts, (2) soft-quarantine threshold that debits a "burst ticket" when triggered so repeated offenders consume credits instead of impacting others.

Alex: Love (2). We should also ensure fallbacks prefer local preemptible pools before shifting regions to keep costs down.

Priya: Proposed rwdctl patch to apply soft-quarantine + ticket debit:
```
# soft quarantine + burst ticket debit
rwdctl tenant update small-tenant-42 --egress-limit 80mbps --soft-quarantine true --burst-ticket debit=1,duration=1h
```
This would route overflow to a local preemptible pool and subtract one burst ticket.

Emily: From billing side, we need a pricing model if we expose tickets. Options: free trial credits, pay-per-ticket (prefund), or subscription windows. Also calculate carveout cost: GPU-hour + egress premium. We should present cost tradeoffs to customers.

Omar: Agreed. Infra action items: add a router-level weight config (per-tenant, per-route), implement ticket accounting in the control plane, and a dashboard for burst-ticket usage and kvcache_regen correlation.

Alex: For immediate relief, let's enable soft-quarantine for the top 10 most-correlated tenants for 60m and prefer preemptible local fallback. If p99 improves, leave policy auto-enabled for repeat offenders (3 events/7d).

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-6001: "egress-fairness + burst-ticket marketplace proposal". Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-fairness

Priya: I'll add a dashboard card: "kvcache_regen_vs_egress_weighted" and a detector that flags >3-host correlation.

Emily: I'll draft pricing options for burst tickets and carveout budgets, include simple examples: 1 ticket = 1 GPU-hour prewarm + 100GB egress at $X. Will sync with product.

Omar: I'll start an RFC for router-weighting heuristics and the burst-ticket API surface (prepay, debit, auto-invite). Will include a rollback policy and observability SLOs.

Alex: Thanks. Short-term ops: Priya to apply 60m soft-quarantine to flagged tenants, Omar to draft RFC, Emily to sketch pricing, infra-bot created INF-6001. We'll review in 2h.
